claims.text: Neutralize unbound toxin outside the CNS w human tetanus immune globulin (TIG).
claims.quote: Neutralize unbound toxin outside the CNS with TIG.

claims.text: Adults: TIG 500 units IM once appears as effective as 3000 to 6000 units and causes less discomfort.
claims.quote: For adults, TIG 500 units IM once appears as effective as higher doses ranging from 3000 to 6000 units and causes less discomfort.
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Antitoxin and toxoid

claims.text: IVIG (contains tetanus antitoxin) may be used if TIG isn't available.
claims.quote: IV immune globulin (IVIG), which contains tetanus antitoxin, may be used if TIG is not available (1, 2).

claims.text: Infection doesn't confer immunity: give a full primary tetanus vaccination series unless one was completed.
claims.quote: Tetanus infection does not confer immunity, so unless their vaccination history indicates completion of a full primary series, patients should receive a full primary tetanus vaccination series using an age-appropriate preparation
claims.locator: Treatment of Tetanus › Antitoxin and toxoid
